record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: INCINEROAR, LITTEN and TORRACAT (the queued units; none has a passive in the catalog). The strategy is shared; the units differ in stars and stats only.
record.summary: Single-target multi-hit SPECIAL damage. The target is flinched for a requested 1000 ms, and round((1 + 0.01 x speed) x 3) hits (speed read at cast time) are queued as delayed commands at delays round(i x 1000 / hits) ms; each requests 1 x the caster's ATK (read at that hit; 2 x at 4 stars) as SPECIAL damage. Each callback tests the stored target's hp > 0 when it enters. Fire-synergy effects (WILDFIRE +1, BLAZE +2, DESOLATE_LAND +3, first match only) add attack to the caster AFTER the damage request of every callback that passed that hp test, even when the request was blocked (protect / skydiving / magicBounce, takenDamage 0) or dealt nothing, and even when it killed the target; a callback whose target already has hp 0 on entry makes neither request nor gain (pinned-strategy probe: WILDFIRE, ATK 30, blocked damage -> ATK 31 after the first callback). The caster then moves to the empty cell closest, by Manhattan distance and over the whole board, to the point target + (target - caster): the FULL vector from the caster to the target applied again from the target, not one sign-step past it; the point may lie off the board.

targeting.who: the cast target passed to the strategy (the caster's current target); every queued hit goes to that same target
targeting.note: hits are skipped once the target's hp is 0; there is no range, position or retargeting check at hit time.

geometry.shape: single target; displacement of the caster to the empty cell nearest (target position + (target - caster))
geometry.destination: Board.getClosestAvailablePlace(target.x + dx, target.y + dy) with dx = target.x - caster.x and dy = target.y - caster.y (the full vector, so a target two cells away gives a point two cells beyond it); the search covers every empty cell on the board, ordered by Manhattan distance (distanceM) with ties kept in board.forEach order after a stable sort; the point itself may lie off the board; null if no cell is empty

declaredRaw.base: the caster's atk at the moment of each hit
declaredRaw.hits: round((1 + 0.01 x speed) x 3), speed at cast time
declaredRaw.spacing: hit i delayed round(i x 1000 / hits) ms

effects.scaling: requested amount per hit: multiplier x atk (atk includes whatever the entity has at that moment, e.g. earlier attack gains from this cast, items per core-mechanics section I); then AP: x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost default true); the cast's single crit flag multiplies every hit if it is true (needs ABILITY_CRIT)
effects.resolution: intermediate, not guaranteed final HP damage: handleDamage includes the SPE_DEF division (damage / (1 + 0.05 x SPE_DEF), ceil, min 1), the shield handling (with the flinch split described under statusEffects) and later modifiers; protect / skydiving / magicBounce block the request (takenDamage 0). The hp > 0 test happens when each callback enters; once the target has hp 0 no further request or gain is made. takenDamage is not used by this ability.

declaredRaw.note: flat attack added after each damaging hit; first matching effect only

effects.scaling: requested amount: addAttack(value, caster = self, apBoost 0, crit false), so neither AP nor crit scales it
effects.resolution: Granted after the damage request of each callback that entered with target.hp > 0, whatever the request did (blocked, zero takenDamage, or lethal). applied amount: applyBigEaterBeltStatBuff multiplies a positive value by 1.25 (rounded down, 0 digits) if the caster holds BIG_EATER_BELT; applyTwistBandBuff affects only negative values, so it does nothing here; atk = max(1, atk + value); not permanent. The gain raises atk for the NEXT hit(s) of this cast and for the basic attacks afterwards.

declaredRaw.destination: closest empty cell (whole board, Manhattan distance) to target + (target - caster)

effects.resolution: if a cell exists: moveTo(..., false) (forcedDisplacement false, canBeMoved not consulted) then resetCooldown(500), i.e. cooldown = round(500 / (0.4 + speed x 0.007)) with the caster's current speed, replacing the cooldown of 100 that moveTo sets. If no empty cell exists the caster stays and the cooldown is not reset.

statusEffects.applicationOrder: at cast time, before any hit and independent of whether damage is dealt
statusEffects.guards: not applied if runeProtect; duration passes through applyStatusDurationReductions; a new flinch replaces the remaining time only if longer
statusEffects.combatEffect: while flinched and while the target's shield is above 0, handleDamage splits the reduced damage using ceil operations, not exact halves: damageOnShield = ceil(reduced x 0.5) and residualDamage = ceil(reduced x 0.5), so an odd reduced amount puts one more in total than reduced (reduced 5 -> 3 on the shield and 3 residual); if damageOnShield reaches the shield, the excess moves to the residual damage and the shield is emptied; takenDamage = shield part + min(residual, hp). Without a shield, or without flinch, the status changes nothing in this handler. This is the only use of status.flinch read in app/core and app/models besides status.ts; other directories not searched. Pinned-helper probe (lines 618-649): reduced 5 with shield 100 -> taken 6, residual 3, shield 97; without flinch taken 5; shield 1 -> residual 5, taken 6.

starBehavior.note: multiplier indexed by the casting entity's stars: 1 for 1-3 stars, 2 only at 4 stars (and the fallback); the 4-star value is not reached by these units' bare star counts (1, 2, 3). maxPP is 80 and range 1 for all three. Catalog base speed is 44 for all three, which gives round(1.44 x 3) = 4 hits at base speed; actual speed at cast time may differ (items, buffs).

record.positionalConditions: The caster needs the target in range to cast (requiresTarget true). Hits do not check range or position, so they still land after the caster has moved behind the target. The move needs at least one empty cell on the board.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state and no modes. Queued hits are entries in the caster's commands list, each tied to the cast's target and crit flag; a later cast adds its own set. Permanent effects: none (the attack gains are not permanent).
record.rawVsResolved: Requested (raw): damage per hit = 1 x atk (4-star: 2 x atk) at hit time, number of hits round((1 + 0.01 x speed) x 3), flinch 1000 ms, attack gain +1/+2/+3 per hit under WILDFIRE/BLAZE/DESOLATE_LAND. Applied: damage after AP/crit, then an intermediate SPE_DEF division (ceil, min 1), shield handling (flinch split with ceil) and later handleDamage modifiers (not guaranteed final HP damage); attack gain (granted after each damage request, whatever its result) after the Big Eater Belt helper (x1.25 rounded down) and the atk floor of 1; flinch after status duration reductions; cooldown reset per resetCooldown with the caster's speed.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleDamage's later modifiers (shields, items, damage-reduction effects, resurrection) - only the SPECIAL speDef division and the minimum of 1 were read
Whether the caster's pending commands keep running when the caster dies, is frozen, asleep or otherwise not updated normally (PokemonState.updateCommands was read, not every state that skips update)
How the caster's atk and speed are built from items, synergies and buffs before the cast (core-mechanics section I covers declared item bonuses)
Crit resolution (only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate and the damage-side multiplier were read)
unresolved: Board.forEach iteration order, which decides ties between equally distant empty cells
Whether hits of a cast still happen if the caster dies before they are due (commands live on the caster entity; not traced)
Whether any other item or synergy effect changes the ability beyond what is listed
Whether the sourceTables pattern's multiplier table is the only star-scaled number: the hit count is a speed formula, not a star table
Gameplay behaviour is not tested; this is source reading with mechanical checks only
